_comment: Path lanes for merge-queue admission (never CI scope: scripts/ci/affected.mjs decides scope from the real diff). The classifier is scripts/ci/lanes.mjs. First match wins, in this order: hot, then each entry of `lanes`, then `per_dir`. Anything that matches nothing is `hot`. `hot` is every glob in scripts/ci/full-run-triggers.json `triggers` (read at run time, never copied) plus `hot_extra` below. Globs are anchored at the repository root: ** crosses directories, * does not. A rule may carry `exclude` globs, which take a path out of that rule only. Two non-hot rules must never both match a file (lanes.test.mjs checks every tracked file).

hot_extra.reason: the generated API document: every route PR rewrites it
the generated client: regenerated from the API document
team switches, including the lane switch itself
repository automation, not only the workflows
the TypeScript config every package extends
the Node version every job runs
licence text: rare, so kept serial
